issues.description: No direct way to get the bounding box / outline of a face or of the ear region of an imported part; I inferred ear x-extents and body width from face areas and centroids (e.g. 278.16 mm2 = 22.8 x 12.2). edges().at_z does not exist.
No way to section the imported servo at a Z height to get its footprint below the ears.

No direct way to get the ears' outline or body cross-section; I had to infer ear extents from face areas/centroids (cad query facing) and bbox. A 'cad measure servo --section z=-1' or per-z outline would help.
cad clearance output for a reference part lists ~20 face lines, mostly 'open'; noisy for the simple check of 'is the clearance 0.5'.
No direct way to get the case-body footprint below the ears of an imported solid; I inferred the body X range (-17.3..5.5) from pixels in a section render plus face-area arithmetic.
cad clearance output for a touching pair lists ~20 per-face lines, mostly 'gap open'; hard to scan.

suggestions.suggestion: Add face/selection bbox output to cad query.
Add a way to query the XY outline/bbox of a slab of a part (z range), e.g. cad measure servo --bbox --zrange -2.5:0.
Filter 'gap open' lines in cad clearance by default.
cad slice names the output after the directory (workspace.gcode.3mf) rather than the part.
Cross-section bbox/outline at a given Z
Face bounding boxes in cad query output
Compact clearance summary (only faces with finite gap)
